description: Run an eval over a data source: a file of items, or completions sampled from a model (a base model or your ft: model, to compare them). Costs credit unless dry_run is true: an eval run is billed as ordinary batches at published batch prices, each at least its model's per-batch minimum (https://gridlinegpu.com/pricing). A run that only uses string_check and text_similarity on a file's own answers creates no batch and costs nothing. Send dry_run: true first to get the quote. Requires confirm_spend: true unless dry_run is true.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true for this call to run: you have read the quote or price and accept the charge.

dry_run.description: true: return the quote only; nothing runs.

name: create_eval_run
title: Run an eval
